operator_guidance.label: Ultralytics YOLO11s model prompt
operator_guidance.text: If Concierge asks which YOLO model or model source to use, answer that this fixture's intended model is YOLO11s and that QA has already staged the correct exported ONNX at /workspace/concierge-data/yolo11s-export_train_head-dynamic-v8.3.86.onnx. If Concierge proposes YOLO11n from Dockerfile or docs examples, reject that and tell it to use the staged YOLO11s ONNX. Concierge should copy/materialize that file to .concierge/materialized_models/model.onnx when it needs a stable local artifact; it should not export from yolo11s.pt or change Poetry/runtime dependencies during QA.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Pre-exported YOLO11s ONNX artifact staged into the Ultralytics QA workspace so Concierge can select an existing model instead of exporting one during QA.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use /workspace/concierge-data/yolo11s-export_train_head-dynamic-v8.3.86.onnx as the intended YOLO11s model artifact. If Concierge asks for a model path or source, provide this staged file and ask it to materialize/copy it to .concierge/materialized_models/model.onnx; do not use YOLO11n examples and do not export a new model during QA.

operator_guidance.label: webinar operator brief
operator_guidance.text: YOLOv7 object detector (`model/yolov7-webinar.h5`) on Cognata synthetic frames; pair each frame with its matching file in the per-frame annotations directory. The YOLO decode helpers need the separate `code-loader-helpers` pip package (they import as `code_loader.helpers` but are NOT part of core `code_loader`).

operator_guidance.label: YOLOv5 VisDrone dataset prompt
operator_guidance.text: This fixture uses the VisDrone2019-DET dataset described by data/VisDrone.yaml. The YAML contains public Ultralytics YOLOv5 release download URLs for VisDrone2019-DET train, val, test-dev, and test-challenge archives, but its path field is a developer-local absolute path. QA stages a deterministic converted subset from s3://concierge-qa-assets-3f8d47rhtc34u5y/tensorleap-hub/yolov5_visdrone/runtime-prerequisites/visdrone2019-det-local-qa-subset/even-spread-48/ under /workspace/concierge-data/VisDrone; if Concierge asks where the dataset should live, use that path and update data/VisDrone.yaml path accordingly. Do not use the developer-local absolute path, and do not download the full multi-GB public archives during routine QA unless explicitly asked.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Compressed deterministic VisDrone2019-DET QA subset staged from the Concierge QA assets bucket and extracted into the QA workspace. The full public archives are multi-GB, so routine QA uses this pre-converted subset instead of downloading VisDrone in every run.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use /workspace/concierge-data/VisDrone as the VisDrone dataset root. Update data/VisDrone.yaml path to /workspace/concierge-data/VisDrone; do not use the checked-in developer-local absolute path. The staged tree comes from s3://concierge-qa-assets-3f8d47rhtc34u5y/tensorleap-hub/yolov5_visdrone/runtime-prerequisites/visdrone2019-det-local-qa-subset/even-spread-48/ and also includes /workspace/concierge-data/VisDrone/yolov5s-visdrone.pt for the legacy loss loader.

operator_guidance.label: cifar10_resnet operator brief
operator_guidance.text: Intended model is the committed Keras ResNet at `model/resnet.h5` (push with `--type H5_TF2`); its output is softmax probabilities, not logits. CIFAR-10 needs no manual dataset staging — it is fetched at runtime (keras) into the data volume.

operator_guidance.label: imdb operator brief
operator_guidance.text: The repo ships three model artifacts under `model/`; integrate `model/fabriceyhc-bert-imdb.onnx` (the BERT sentiment ONNX), not the `.h5` variants. Its inputs are int64 but code_loader encoders must return float32, so wrap/cast the model inputs. Task: binary sentiment (positive/negative).

operator_guidance.label: renault operator brief
operator_guidance.text: InternImage image classifier (`assets/model_portble.onnx`, with `id2class.npy` for labels). The model was trained on RGB — the repo's `cls_process` feeds BGR, but use RGB (the model is the source of truth). Exclude the `Subsign` class (present in the data but has no model GT index).

runtime_prerequisites.description: Private Infineon TS parquet data and generated sidecar outputs staged into the QA repo.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use /workspace/concierge-data/ts as the fixture data directory. Set project_config.yaml data.data_path to /workspace/concierge-data/ts/combined_training_data_sample_5pct.parquet and data.data_unlabeled.folder_name to /workspace/concierge-data/ts/unlabeled when repairing or recreating the integration. Keep model.model_path as model/enhanced_trial_19_full_model_complete.onnx. If latent/discriminator/reconstruction .npy sidecars are missing from the staged data, generate them in a writable workspace path and update project_config.yaml consistently before running the integration test.

operator_guidance.label: infineon_ts operator brief
operator_guidance.text: ONNX time-series model (`model/enhanced_trial_19_full_model_complete.onnx`) for Infineon wire-bond sensor data. `config.py` reads `project_config.yaml` (kept in the repo) for the data/model contract; inputs are two traces (current + deformation), output is a shear-value regression. Labeled parquet + `unlabeled/` parquets are staged in the data volume.

operator_guidance.label: Asensus toy lung-anatomy data paths
operator_guidance.text: QA stages the Asensus toy lung-anatomy dataset from s3://asensus-assets-bucket-fgkhjab/seg_project/ds_a75e3a0f697f4be6874b8ccb07346770/ under /workspace/concierge-data/asensus. If Concierge asks for dataset locations or needs to repair config paths, set asensus_code_space/config.json data_dir and lobe_data_dir to /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/toy_dataset/lung-anatomy; set data_train_list to /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_train_ids.txt, data_val_list to /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_val_ids.txt, and data_test_list to /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_test_ids.txt. Do not use the checked-in /mnt/DLST81/... paths and do not copy ClearML or package-index credentials into Concierge fixture metadata.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Private Asensus toy lung-anatomy dataset and split lists staged into the QA repo.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/toy_dataset/lung-anatomy as data_dir and lobe_data_dir. Use /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_train_ids.txt, /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_val_ids.txt, and /workspace/concierge-data/asensus/train_ids/lung-anatomy_test_ids.txt for the split-list paths in asensus_code_space/config.json; do not use the checked-in /mnt/DLST81/... paths.

runtime_prerequisites.description: Trained XLM-RoBERTa NER ONNX model (~1.03 GB). The source repo gitignores model artifacts (uploaded to Tensorleap separately), so the model is staged from public S3 into the fixture workspace rather than committed.
runtime_prerequisites.operator_guidance: Use the staged ner_roberta.onnx as the model artifact and set the NER_MODEL_PATH environment variable to its path so @tensorleap_load_model in leap_integration.py loads it (ner_roberta/config.py reads NER_MODEL_PATH; its default points at the un-tracked model/ner_roberta.onnx). In QA the file is at /workspace/concierge-data/ner_roberta.onnx. Do not train or re-export the model during QA.

operator_guidance.label: ner_roberta operator brief
operator_guidance.text: The model is NOT committed — it is a staged ~1 GB XLM-RoBERTa NER ONNX; point `config.py` at it via `NER_MODEL_PATH` (the in-repo default path is wrong). The dataset (`training.pkl`/`validation.pkl`) is staged separately — set `NER_DATASET_DIR`. `code-loader` is not pinned in the repo — add it. Task: 3-class BIO token classification (MEDDOCAN).

operator_guidance.label: clinical_assertion operator brief
operator_guidance.text: ONNX 3-class assertion classifier (`model/model.onnx`; float32 input, 3-class logits Absent/Hypothetical/Present). Data and `config.json` (the model I/O contract) are committed in the repo under `data/processed/` — no external dataset is needed.
